incident-bot: [pagerduty] SYNTHETIC_ALERT fired for probe-group=canary-eu-reader (eu-west-1) — 6/6 consecutive failures in 2m. Probe run id: prb_9f3a. Pager: https://pdt.redwood.ai/incidents/PRB12345

pagerduty-bot: Assigned to @aleks (primary on-call). Escalation in 5m if no ack.

aleks: ack — I'm taking this. first pass: is this regional only? any customer errors yet?

maya: seeing elevated failures in apac but ~30% of eu volume. EU is worst.

aleks: quick health check:
```
curl -sS https://canary-runner.eu-west1.redwood.internal/health | jq .
# -> {"ok":false,"error":"connect timeout"}
```

samir: tail from prober host shows TCP resets and backlog; possible upstream connection saturation. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T10:12:01Z prober[pid=4123]: dial tcp 10.0.4.12:443: i/o timeout
2026-03-15T10:12:15Z prober[pid=4123]: connection reset by peer
2026-03-15T10:12:27Z prober[pid=4123]: backlog queue length=512 trying new socket
```

incident-bot: Auto-mitigation triggered: scaling prober pool in eu-west-1 +2 replicas (policy: synth-autoscale). Command: `infra scale prober --region eu-west1 --delta 2`.

aleks: scaling applied — new prober pods scheduled. watching success rate.

irene: pushing temporary fanout gate to slow down concurrent targets to reduce socket pressure:
```
PATCH /config/prober
{ "synth.prober.max_concurrency": 100 }
```

samir: after scale+gate, failures dropped to 1/6 over last 60s. metrics: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/PROB/canary-eu?panelId=7

maya: confirm: prod customer traffic unaffected (no surge in 5xx or errors). checked traces for last 15m — clean.

pagerduty-bot: Pager auto-escalation canceled; incident acknowledged and mitigation in progress. Will auto-resolve if metric stays stable for 10m.

aleks: handing monitoring to next on-call @maya for 30m observation window. Opening follow-up ticket: SYNTH-1876 (owner: @samir) to investigate connection pool and prober scaling behavior.

samir: noted. will collect more logs, heap/profile prober binary, and check kernel socket limits across hosts.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: canary success rate returned to baseline after scaling and gating. Closing pagerduty incident PRB12345. Postmortem: to be created if recurrence within 7d.

aleks: thanks team. Posting a brief summary to #incidents-postmortems and assigning follow-ups. :thumbsup:
